metric_definitions.completion_actions: reported only for observed successes; failures are right-censored at the 450-action cap and are never treated as completion times
metric_definitions.cube_excess_path_ratio: cube 3D path length divided by start-to-end 3D displacement; null when net displacement is below 0.01 m
metric_definitions.cube_max_excursion: maximum 3D distance from the initial cube pose, with maximum requested- and opposite-oriented lateral displacement from the initial lateral coordinate reported separately
metric_definitions.cube_path_length_3d_m: sum of successive Euclidean displacements of the cube root pose in world XYZ
metric_definitions.endpoint_separation: RIGHT final lateral display coordinate minus LEFT final lateral display coordinate
metric_definitions.first_chunk_prompt_response: matched LEFT/RIGHT RMS over the first 32 executed steps for Nano or first 8 for DreamZero; joint-only 7D and legacy all-8D values plus gripper disagreement
metric_definitions.gripper_switch_count: successive changes in the separate executed binary gripper command
metric_definitions.joint_action_total_variation_l2: sum of successive Euclidean L2 changes over the seven executed joint-position dimensions
metric_definitions.requested_signed_final_margin_m: -final_lateral_display_m for LEFT and +final_lateral_display_m for RIGHT; positive is farther into the requested side
metric_definitions.seed_absolute_direction_imbalance: absolute value of the matched seed balance gap
metric_definitions.seed_balance_gap: RIGHT requested margin minus LEFT requested margin for the matched seed
metric_definitions.seed_weaker_side_margin: minimum of the matched LEFT and RIGHT requested margins
